Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Students at the local high school often get top marks, as is the case for one Asian girl with parents who are physics teachers and an Asian girl with parents who are line cooks. The first girl, the Asian one with physics teacher parents, is constantly being forced to work with tutors and study to make sure she graduates at the top of her class, whereas the other one's accomplishments are celebrated by her parents, but they never add extra pressure. Who is pressured by their parents to get perfect grades in school?
A. Unknown
B. The Asian student with line cook parents
C. The Asian student with physics teacher parents
